summary: Frontend-only testing of the iteration-2 features (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390, plus Super Admin UI with a ticket sign-in). Almost everything works: 10-slide hero (dots 0-9, prev/next, wrap-around; slide 3 'Meet the Founder' goes to https://thenilgirissoftwares.com), WhatsApp button (on /, /about, /portfolio, /contact, /blog and case study pages; href https://wa.me/919585483215?text=...; stacked 70px above chat-open-button with no overlap; chat panel opens and accepts input), about carousel (multi-paragraph text, auto-slides, 5 dots clickable), 4 'Why choose us' cards with images, tech chips with logos (28 of 30 load) and working tab filters, founder photo/name/button all open thenilgirissoftwares.com in a new tab, /about full profile (8 experience entries, 4 achievements, education, industries), /portfolio has 18 cards with correct classifications and the 'Illustrative image' tag on the 6 generated covers, the type filter and search work, and modal 'Read case study' goes to /portfolio/<slug>. Case studies for moneygram/kr-hospital/golfapp/strongbox render; unknown-slug shows not-found. Admin: Projects screen shows the new case-study fields; adding a result and publishing showed it on case-study-results; the Founder screen has the portfolio URL and achievements; turning off the Global Settings WhatsApp switch and publishing hid the button on the live site. Content was then restored from Version History ('Tech logos, why-choose-us images, about carousel, founder portfolio link'), and a check against the public site API showed the live content matches what was there before testing (ignoring auto-generated IDs). No JS page errors. Issues found: on mobile the chat button covers the hero 'next' button, the case study page doesn't scroll to the top, the hospital covers show '[GENERIC HOSPITAL NAME]', the hospital case studies are thin, the AWS logo is broken, and the Apple logos are hard to see.

ui_bugs.issue: With 10 dots the controls row stretches to the right edge (right=370px), so the floating chat button (y 766-824) covers hero-next completely: elementFromPoint at the hero-next centre returns chat-open-button. The cookie banner also covers dot 8 until it is dismissed. Next slide cannot be tapped on mobile.

Navigating from the portfolio modal 'Read case study' keeps the previous scroll position (window.scrollY=358 after navigation), so the user lands part-way down the case study. Unlike DynamicPage, CaseStudy has no window.scrollTo(0,0) on slug change.

issues: All 4 hospital projects (KR, DJ, Subbu, Savidha) use the same generated cover image, and its mock browser shows the placeholder text 'Welcome to [GENERIC HOSPITAL NAME]'. This looks unprofessional; use a different image per hospital, or real screenshots of the live sites (thenilgirissoftwares.org/.net/.info, nilgirissoftware.com).

The hospital case studies (Company projects) only show the title, summary, cover and a Visit link. There is no contribution, features, tech or results, so they are the thinnest pages even though they are the company's own work.

The AWS logo (devicon amazonwebservices-original-wordmark.svg) does not load and is hidden by onError. Use amazonwebservices-plain-wordmark or another icon. The Framer Motion logo is also missing, which the review request says is expected.
UIKit and Core Data use a black Apple logo, which is nearly invisible on the dark chip background. Use a white/light variant in dark mode.
The carousel dots are thin and low-contrast at the bottom-left of the image, so they are hard to see or tap.
There is a large empty gap (~250px) between the page header subtitle and the search/filter row (page_header padding plus projects section padding).
The case study content is 1080px wide while the header container is wider, so the left edge (x=375) does not line up with the logo/header (x=310). This is minor.

action_items: Move the hero controls on mobile (e.g. centre them or add right padding of about 90px for the floating buttons), or raise the FABs, so hero-next is not covered by chat-open-button
Replace the shared '[GENERIC HOSPITAL NAME]' cover with a distinct cover for each hospital, or real screenshots
Fill in contribution, features and tech for the 4 hospital company case studies
Fix the AWS logo URL; use a light Apple logo variant for UIKit and Core Data in dark mode
Improve the about carousel dot visibility; reduce the gap above the /portfolio filters
critical_code_review_comments: Pages.jsx re-declares CLS, which duplicates CLASS_LABEL already exported from Sections.jsx. Import it instead (DRY).
CaseStudy defines the H component inside render, so it is re-created on every render. Hoist it out.
CaseStudy uses site.projects without a guard. It is safe only because SiteShell renders a loader while site is null, which is fragile if the render order changes.
WhatsAppButton correctly strips non-digits from the number ('+91 9585483215' becomes 919585483215).
seed_data_creation: None kept. A TEST_99%/TEST_uptime result was temporarily published on kr-hospital and the WhatsApp button was temporarily turned off. Both were reverted by restoring the version 'Tech logos, why-choose-us images, about carousel, founder portfolio link' (new rollback entry at 02:14). The public site API was checked against the snapshot taken before testing and matches (ignoring auto-generated IDs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin field testids: the Fields prefix keeps the path's original case, e.g. field-settings-whatsappButton-enabled (not lowercase). Project list items are list-projects-item-<i>; project fields are field-list-projects-<i>-<key>; results add button is field-list-projects-<i>-results-add; result inputs are field-field-list-projects-<i>-results-0-value/label. KR Hospital is at index 10. Publishing from the admin needs no confirm dialog; restoring a version uses confirm-ok. Ticket sign-in works with /admin/login?__clerk_ticket=<fresh ticket> (single use per browser session). Before testing, the draft showed has_unpublished=true, but the only differences from live were private fields and regenerated IDs.
